summary: Master risk control and compliance in credit operations through our specialized training. Equip yourself with essential skills for success in the industry.
lede: Risk control and compliance in credit operations focuses on strengthening lending oversight for credit, compliance, and audit professionals. Participants practise assessing borrower and portfolio exposure, designing internal controls and monitoring processes, and spotting early warning signs in troubled accounts. The course also covers compliance reviews, ethical decision-making, and clear audit documentation.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals involved in credit management, compliance, and control functions.
audience: Legal and documentation officers in credit departments
Policy and governance professionals in financial supervision
modules: Foundations of Risk and Compliance in Credit Operations
Monitoring, Reporting, and Audit in Credit Operations
Managing Non-Performing Loans and Credit Failures
Ethical and Behavioral Dimensions of Compliance
Technology and Automation in Risk and Compliance
Building a Sustainable Risk and Compliance Framework
prerequisites: Participants should have experience in credit operations or risk management. Familiarity with basic compliance principles is recommended.
